claims: Gene Hackman died at age 95 in February 2025 at his Santa Fe home.
Betsy Arakawa is Gene Hackman's wife.

Gene Hackman and Betsy Arakawa were found together on February 26, 2025.
The bodies of Gene Hackman and Betsy Arakawa were found following a welfare check.
Investigators ruled out foul play, citing natural causes.
A coroner confirmed that Gene Hackman died of hypertensive cardiovascular disease.
A coroner confirmed that advanced Alzheimer's was a contributing factor to Gene Hackman's death.
